integrity: The exact integer graph inequalities are proved analytically; standalone exact rational checks and seeded test graphs corroborate but do not replace the proof. The earlier 1977 report carries month-only dating, not a verified publication day; the day-resolved focal report is dated 2008-07-18.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to finite connected simple unit-weight graphs, diameter at most three, standard two-level Richardson backward Euler, and sufficiently small positive steps; no graph-order cutoff is claimed for weighted networks, directed operators, other refinements, or large steps. Historical graph-specific equivalence remains possible.
title: Ten vertices are necessary and sufficient for local Richardson positivity failure at graph diameter three
